expectedFailures.decision: The Artifact data model is supported and validated when an artifact exists, but ASC does not ask its deterministic Codex adapter to synthesize the four model-selected artifact shapes used by this TCK test. A2A does not require every response to contain an artifact.

review.condition: Remove when the TCK conditions artifact-shape scenarios on advertised behavior, or when ASC deliberately adds those artifact-producing behaviors.

expectedFailures.decision: ASC validates Message objects but always chooses the permitted Task branch of SendMessageResponse. The TCK scenario requires the optional direct-Message response branch and therefore does not test the conditional Message shape invariant in isolation.

review.condition: Remove when the TCK validates Message structure only after a SUT chooses that response branch, or when ASC adds direct Message responses.

expectedFailures.decision: ASC returns ContentTypeNotSupportedError as required. At the pinned revision the registry entry omits expected_error, so the generic requirement runner treats the required error response as a failure.

review.condition: Remove on the first pinned TCK revision whose CORE-SEND-003 registry entry declares ContentTypeNotSupportedError.

expectedFailures.decision: ASC implements blocking-by-default behavior. The pinned parametrized runner reuses the same complete-task messageId for a request body that differs from an earlier requirement, and ASC correctly rejects that conflicting reuse rather than weakening idempotency.

review.condition: Remove when each distinct TCK request receives a distinct messageId or each requirement runs against isolated SUT state.

expectedFailures.decision: ASC generates and returns contextId when it creates a context. The pinned parametrized runner reuses complete-task with a different request body, so strict idempotency rejects the request before the response invariant can be observed.

review.condition: Remove when each distinct TCK request receives a distinct messageId or each requirement runs against isolated SUT state.

expectedFailures.decision: ASC accepts and preserves client-provided contextId values, so the conditional requirement for agents that cannot accept a value is inapplicable. The pinned request also collides with the shared complete-task messageId before that policy can be observed.

review.condition: Remove when the TCK makes this conditional case capability- or behavior-aware; reclassify if ASC ever restricts accepted contextId values.
